name: Pervasive E2213KS0E1
description: 2.13-inch monochrome wide-temperature panel, 212 × 104; tentative 2023 electrical characterization.
scope: Panel and its display driver/reference circuit under cited test conditions; host MCU, radio, upstream converter, optional adapter board, touch and frontlight consumption are not included.
source_note: Pervasive Displays Incorporated, Tentative, 2023-04-17; PDF pages 1, 13, 14, 17, 18, 20. https://static.chipdip.ru/lib/642/DOC050642272.pdf
energy_note: 3 V × 2.3 mA × 2.4 s. Current trace on page 14 supports mean-current interpretation. Vendor test jig and price-label pattern, 25 ± 2 °C.
idle_note: Image retention without power does not establish standby current of the powered controller or attached board.
